data.gender_notes: Bharvad is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bharvad is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Bhara' meaning 'God' and 'Vad' meaning 'Blessing'. This name signifies the blessings of the Gods upon an individual. The name Bharvad carries the meaning “God's Blessing” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bharvad usually hope their child will grow to embody god's blessing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Bharvad belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's Blessing.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bharvad total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
